level_xp_note: level_xp[n-1] = total XP needed for level n (level 2 at 300 XP, level 5 at 6500 XP, level 20 at 355000 XP)
hit_points: level 1: hit die maximum + CON modifier; each later level: one hit die roll (or its average, rounded up) + CON modifier, at least 1
attack_roll: d20 + ability modifier + proficiency bonus (+ magic bonus); it hits when the total is at least the target's AC; a natural 20 always hits and is a critical hit (roll the damage dice twice), a natural 1 always misses
attack_ability: STR for melee weapons, DEX for ranged weapons; a 'finesse' weapon uses the better of STR and DEX
damage_roll: weapon damage dice + the same ability modifier (+ magic bonus)
resting: a long rest (an inn, a bed) restores all hit points
selling: equipment sells for half its cost; magic items without a cost cannot be bought or sold
